import sys

args = sys.argv[1:]
num = "-n" in args
names = [a for a in args if a != "-n"]
out = []
status = 0
cnt = 0


def emit(data):
    global cnt
    if not num:
        out.append(data)
        return
    for line in data.splitlines(keepends=True):
        cnt += 1
        if not line.endswith("\n"):
            line += "\n"
        out.append("%6d\t%s" % (cnt, line))


if not names:
    emit(sys.stdin.buffer.read().decode("latin-1"))
else:
    for n in names:
        try:
            with open(n, "rb") as f:
                data = f.read().decode("latin-1")
        except (FileNotFoundError, IsADirectoryError):
            out.append("cat: %s: No such file\n" % n)
            status = 1
            continue
        emit(data)

sys.stdout.buffer.write("".join(out).encode("latin-1"))
sys.stdout.flush()
sys.exit(status)
